items.name: Student Support Centre
items.description: Book a counselling appointment by phone, email, or visiting SSC. For urgent assistance, use the Emergency page; SSC does not provide emergency services.
steps: Call 0820-2922430 during office hours or email student.support@manipal.edu.
Visit No. 125, opposite New International Guest House, for appointment enquiries.
Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm, except third Saturdays and MAHE holidays.

items.name: SSC Therapy & Medicare FAQ
items.description: Read how counselling works, confidentiality guidance, and Medicare coverage for SSC sessions.

items.name: Student Health Clinic & Medicare
items.description: Find routine medical care at the first floor of the New Outpatient block, Kasturba Hospital. Call 0820-2922057 for an appointment and carry your student ID.
items.appliesTo: Review the official Medicare guidance for coverage and exclusions.

items.name: MIT Technical Clubs
items.description: Explore computing, engineering, science, and finance clubs. Open a club profile for its official contact and ask about recruitment.

items.name: MIT Cultural & Community Clubs
items.description: Find theatre, dance, music, literature, photography, volunteering, and other student groups through the official club profiles.

items.name: Major Student Project Teams
items.description: Explore teams building vehicles, robots, autonomous systems, and cybersecurity projects. Use the published team email to enquire about joining.

items.name: MARENA Indoor Stadium
items.description: Find the gym, jogging track, badminton, squash, basketball, and other sports facilities.
items.appliesTo: Confirm current membership fees, facility schedules, and entry requirements at MARENA reception.

items.name: Student Council & Peer Support
items.description: Find Student Teaching Student, the Mentorship Programme, Career Development Center, and Club Expo through MIT Student Council.
steps: Email president.scmit@manipal.edu to enquire about the programme you need.
The Student Council office is on the ground floor of Academic Block 1.

items.name: Innovation Centre & Makerspace
items.description: Explore prototyping tools, 3D printing, Apple Creative Studio, and support for developing a startup idea. Contact the centre about access and training.

items.name: Manipal Universal Technology Business Incubator
items.description: Find startup incubation, infrastructure, mentorship, and funding support through MUTBI.

items.name: AICTE IDEA Lab
items.description: Learn about MIT's multidisciplinary facility for innovation, design, and hands-on prototyping.

items.name: Anti-Ragging Committee
items.description: Find MIT's anti-ragging committee and published contact route for reporting ragging concerns.

items.name: Sexual Harassment Complaints Committee
items.description: Open the official committee page for published members and contact details when seeking help or reporting sexual harassment.

items.name: MIT Festivals & Events
items.description: Find official information about Revels and TechTatva. Check the event organisers for current dates and registration.

items.name: MIT Campus Hostel Information
items.description: Find the official hostel office contact and linked hostel fee documents. Check the academic year on each fee schedule.
